items.exchange_summary: HDFC Bank Limited reports that the Special Resolution for the re-appointment of Mrs. Lily Vadera, DIN 09400410, as an Independent Director has been passed with the requisite majority. The resolution was approved via postal ballot on Friday, November 20, 2026. Scrutinizer Mr. B. Narasimhan of M/s. BN & Associates confirmed the results. Out of 48,41,772 members holding shares as of the cut-off date of Friday, October 16, 2026, 12,114 members voted. The votes in favor accounted for 99.092 percent of valid votes cast, while votes against accounted for 0.908 percent. The e-voting period ran from Thursday, October 22, 2026, to Friday, November 20, 2026. The results are deemed passed on the last date of the e-voting period.

items.subject: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR Regulations'.
items.exchange_summary: Infosys Limited’s wholly owned subsidiary, Infosys Singapore Pte. Ltd., will enter into a joint venture agreement with NTT DOCOMO, INC. Infosys is investing JPY 1.59bn to acquire a 10.1% stake in NTT Docomo Playspace, Inc. This joint venture is anchored by NTT Docomo and focuses on creating a virtual economic ecosystem in the metaverse in Japan. Infosys will serve as a minority investor and strategic technology and AI partner. As a minority shareholder, Infosys holds the right to nominate one director to the Board of the joint venture company. The transaction does not fall within related party transactions. The parties have no relationship with the promoter or promoter group. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

This applies to 649,835 partly paid-up equity shares with outstanding calls. Interest at 10% per annum is applicable on delayed payments.
